summary: Iteration 2 — VERIFICATION of iteration_1's CRITICAL Supabase concurrency fix and Dashboard .catch wrapper. Backend pytest suite 23/23 PASS (sequential). NEW concurrency test (test_concurrency.py) runs 5 bursts of 4 parallel calls + 24 parallel calls → ALL 200 OK, ZERO 500s. Frontend: login → dashboard loads with ALL 4 stat cards populated (7 socios, 6 notifs, 2800 puntos, BASICO×7) with NO React error overlay on first load NOR across 5 consecutive reloads. Zero page errors, zero JS exceptions. Full nav flow validated: /socios (list + filters + search), socio detail (transacciones + puntos), /notificaciones (6 entries), /aliados, /configuracion (QR present), public /registro/umania-demo (success state with 500 puntos + Añadir a Wallet CTA), /registro/no-such-slug (shows 'Tarjeta no disponible'), logout & protected redirect. Known trade-off (already flagged by main agent): every request creates a fresh Supabase client → ~9–11s latency per endpoint, so the UI needs generous waits (10–12s) for Socios/Notificaciones/Aliados first loads — functional but slow.

minor.issue: High latency (~9-11s per request) because sb_dep/anon_dep creates a fresh supabase.create_client on every request — safe but slow. For production consider HTTP/1.1 (http2=False) on a single shared client, or lightweight token-cached async client.

issues: 'Cargando...' spinner visible for ~8-10s due to backend latency; consider skeleton loaders or optimistic UI

action_items: (Optional, perf) Re-introduce a shared supabase client BUT force HTTP/1.1 by passing a custom httpx.Client(http2=False) — avoids the stream-state race that caused the original RemoteProtocolError while keeping latency low (~200ms vs 9-11s).
(Nice-to-have UX) Replace 'Cargando...' plain text with skeleton rows on /socios and /notificaciones so the ~10s first-load feels less broken.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py sb_dep/anon_dep creates a new Client per request — correct and safe for concurrency but trades ~9-11s per call. The underlying fix is valid; perf optimisation is a follow-up.
Dashboard.jsx safe(p) wrapper correctly swallows per-call errors and returns null — confirmed: 5 reloads produce no overlay and no unhandled rejections.

No data-testid on 'Nuevo socio' and 'Enviar mensaje' top-bar buttons (Dashboard.jsx). Tests had to fall back to text-based selectors. Recommend data-testid='quick-add-socio' and 'quick-send-notification'.
No data-testid on Layout 'Cerrar sesión' logout button — falls back to text. Recommend data-testid='logout-button'.
Two harmless 404 resource loads in console on public /registro page (likely favicon or manifest asset). Non-blocking.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 1 RCA (now resolved): shared module-level supabase.Client used HTTP/2 multiplexed connection → uvicorn's burst-concurrency caused httpcore.RemoteProtocolError('Server disconnected') → 500s. Fix applied: FastAPI Depends(sb_dep)/Depends(anon_dep) factory creates a fresh Client per request. Verified by (a) 5×4 parallel-call bursts, (b) 24 parallel calls, (c) 5 consecutive dashboard reloads in real browser. Zero 500s, zero overlays. Trade-off: per-request client instantiation adds ~8-10s per call — optimal fix would be a custom httpx.Client(http2=False) singleton passed to supabase.create_client() to force HTTP/1.1 and eliminate the stream-state race without the latency penalty.
